newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel to ease closure on West Bank, Gaza.
newsitem.headline: Israel to ease closure on West Bank, Gaza.

text.p: Israel said on Saturday it would allow 20,000 Palestinians to enter the Jewish state for work, easing a closure imposed on the West Bank and Gaza Strip after a Palestinian bombing last month.

The army sealed off the West Bank and Gaza on March 21 after an Islamic militant killed three Israeli women at a Tel Aviv cafe and died himself when a bomb he intended to plant there exploded prematurely.
"Twenty-thousand Palestinians over 35 years of age who are married and hold permits to work in Israel will be allowed in from the West Bank and Gaza on Sunday morning," an army spokesman said.
Palestinians said nearly 50,000 people from the West Bank and Gaza crossed daily into Israel for work prior to the bombing.

The attack in Tel Aviv came on the heels of Israel's groundbreaking on a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem which sparked widespread Arab anger and a wave of Palestinian unrest in the West Bank and Gaza.
